title: Terms of the Agreement: Acceptance of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) and the Down Payment
content:
**Terms of the Agreement, Part B — Acceptance**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements), Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative

**B.1 Who accepts.** Accepting the agreement is the member's own commitment and is given only by the member, through one of the tier's acceptance methods.

**B.2 Acceptance window.** The member must accept within the tier's acceptance window of calendar days after the agreement was offered. The calendar days are counted from the day after the offer date shown on the agreement, the last day of the window being the last day of the count. Acceptance on that last day is within the window; acceptance on any later day is not.

| Hypothetical offer date | Window | Days counted | Last day to accept | Not accepted in the window if accepted on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| June 10 | 3 calendar days | June 11, 12, 13 | June 13 | June 14 |
| June 10 | 5 calendar days | June 11 through June 15 | June 15 | June 16 |
| June 10 | 2 calendar days | June 11, 12 | June 12 | June 13 |

**B.3 Down payment before acceptance.** The down payment, less any pledge counted toward it, must have posted on the service account through one of the tier's down payment channels on or after the offer date before the acceptance is recorded. A payment posted before the offer date does not meet this term, nor does a payment through a channel the tier does not list; both are read from the payments posted on the service account.

**B.4 Effects of acceptance.** On acceptance, where the tier clears notices, an outstanding disconnect notice is cleared, and where the tier provides reconnection on acceptance, a disconnected account qualifies for reconnection under the Electric Service by Rate Schedule rules. On acceptance the agreement passes from offered to active status.

**B.5 Expiry.** An offer not accepted in the window expires and nothing is moved; the agreement passes from offered to expired status.

**B.6 Retired clause.** The following clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis for the amount moved into the agreement:

> ~~On acceptance the arranged amount is moved off the service account's past-due balance as the balance transfer.~~ — no longer in force.
